## Fix

`window.Start` now floors to the start of the window `[start, start+60)`, so an instant belongs to the window already started and an instant exactly on a boundary starts the next window — matching the behavior already documented in `docs/pipeline.md` and the code comment:

```go
q := unix / Size
if unix < 0 && unix%Size != 0 {
	q-- // floor, not truncation toward zero
}
return q * Size
```
